name: cedarville-people-search
title: Cedarville People Search
description: Search the Cedarville University student/staff directory
author: taciturnaxolotl

preferences.name: engineUrl
preferences.title: cedarengine URL
preferences.description: Where cedarengine is listening. Leave blank to disable the schedule fallback entirely.

preferences.name: engineToken
preferences.title: cedarengine Token
preferences.description: The BEARER_TOKEN from cedarengine's .env. Every route but /health requires it.

preferences.name: myPersonId
preferences.title: Your Directory Id
preferences.description: Your own id, for My Day, Course Fit and Textbooks. Find it in Search Cedarville Directory: open yourself and use Copy ID.

commands.name: search-directory
commands.title: Search Cedarville Directory
commands.description: Search the Cedarville directory by name

preferences.name: demoMode
preferences.title: Demo Mode
preferences.description: Redact personal information for screenshots and demos
preferences.label: Hide personal data

commands.name: quiet-rooms
commands.title: Find a Quiet Room
commands.description: Empty classrooms right now, ranked by how quiet the building around them is

preferences.name: homeBuilding
preferences.title: Start From
preferences.description: Building to measure walking distance from. A partial name is fine -- "McChesney" matches "McChesney Hall". Leave blank to rank by quiet alone.

commands.name: registration
commands.title: Sections Filling up
commands.description: Which sections are gaining students fastest, from recorded seat counts

commands.name: class-roster
commands.title: Who's in a Class
commands.description: Search a section and see the students in it, rebuilt from booklists

commands.name: campus-now
commands.title: Campus Right Now
commands.description: Where everyone is scheduled to be, building by building

commands.name: my-day
commands.title: My Day
commands.description: Where you need to be next, and somewhere quiet to sit until then

commands.name: course-fit
commands.title: Would This Class Fit
commands.description: Which sections of a course fit your week, walking time included

commands.name: free-together
commands.title: Free Together
commands.description: When a group of people are all free at once

commands.name: textbooks
commands.title: My Textbooks
commands.description: Your books with their ISBNs, and who else needs each one

commands.name: faculty
commands.title: Professors
commands.description: What a professor teaches this term, where and when

commands.name: dorms
commands.title: Who Lives Where
commands.description: Halls room by room, from the directory's own dorm fields
